_comment: Full CI gate thresholds (Appflow §4.2, job 3). This is the FINAL gate, checked once the agent/LLM triage layer exists on top of the deterministic T1-T4 cascade. See GATE 1 in the Implementation Plan (§6.2) for the earlier, looser deterministic-only checkpoint (auto_match_rate >= 0.75, false_match_rate <= 0.005), which eval/gate.py also supports via --auto-match-rate-min/--false-match-rate-max overrides.
